verdict.rationale: 1Password stores one-time passwords [docs-20] and shows them on Apple Watch [docs-19]. It runs on iOS/iPadOS [docs-17], and a user reports desktop and mobile apps both working well [comm-9]. Community remarks that vaults are no longer stored locally [comm-8] suggest cloud-backed storage, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents automatic sync across phone, tablet and computer. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of automatic cross-device sync, confirmation that OTP tokens appear on all devices at once, independent hands-on corroboration of sync behavior.
